title: Pan-Seared Cod with Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring crispy cod and wholesome pilaf. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the cod fillet and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the cod with salt to taste.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the cod to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the cod is cooking, heat a tablespoon of oil in a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add the cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the oil.
Remove the cod from the oven and top with crushed hcrispy.
Serve the cod on top of the pilaf.
Garnish with additional hcrispy if desired.
